name: SP Medifort Hospital
summary: SP Medifort is a 475-bed multispecialty hospital on the International Airport Service Road in Thiruvananthapuram. It is accredited by Joint Commission International under its 8th edition standards and by NABH under its 6th edition, and has an international patients help desk.
highlights: Accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI) under the 8th edition standards
NABH accreditation under the 6th edition standards; laboratory accredited by NABL
Orthopaedics and spine, neurology and neurosurgery, cardiology and cardiothoracic surgery, robotic surgery, oncology
